quotes.text: The enabled actions on the new mail notification, in order.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: MailGlue records mail.biff.alert.enabled_actions as an ordered string list. The usage metric is a labeled counter whose labels identify concrete actions in MailNotificationManager. The callback increments the counter before runAction, so a count does not prove the operation completed. Review asks for the label meaning to be documented and rejects replacing the stored comma-separated format with spaces. Later accepted IDs name behaviors, such as mark-as-read and delete, instead of historical action1/action2 positions. No telemetry or action was executed.
title: Notification action telemetry separates ordered configuration from dispatch counts
